title: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.8.0 does not check that a lesson belongs to the course a course creator…
description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.8.0 contain an authorization flaw where the plugin does not verify that a lesson belongs to the course a course creator is authorized to manage before allowing the lesson to be moved. This flaw permits users with the Course Creator role to move lessons from other creators' courses into their own and access the content of those lessons.
